record.bible_text: Now these <FI>are<Fi> the commandments<WH04687>, the statutes<WH02706>, and the judgments<WH04941>, which the LORD<WH03068> your God<WH0430> commanded<WH06680><WTH8765> to teach<WH03925><WTH8763> you, that ye might do<WH06213><WTH8800> <FI>them<Fi>  in the land<WH0776> whither ye go<WH05674><WTH8802> to possess<WH03423><WTH8800> it: <RF>go: Heb. pass over<Rf>

That thou mightest fear<WH03372><WTH8799> the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430>, to keep<WH08104><WTH8800> all his statutes<WH02708> and his commandments<WH04687>, which I command<WH06680><WTH8764> thee, thou, and thy son<WH01121>, and thy son's<WH01121> son<WH01121>, all the days<WH03117> of thy life<WH02416>; and that thy days<WH03117> may be prolonged<WH0748><WTH8686>.

Hear<WH08085><WTH8804> therefore, O Israel<WH03478>, and observe<WH08104><WTH8804> to do<WH06213><WTH8800> <FI>it<Fi> ; that it may be well<WH03190><WTH8799> with thee, and that ye may increase<WH07235><WTH8799> mightily<WH03966>, as the LORD<WH03068> God<WH0430> of thy fathers<WH01> hath promised<WH01696><WTH8765> thee, in the land<WH0776> that floweth<WH02100><WTH8802> with milk<WH02461> and honey<WH01706>.<CM>
Hear<WH08085><WTH8798>, O Israel<WH03478>: The LORD<WH03068> our God<WH0430> <FI>is<Fi> one<WH0259> LORD<WH03068>:
And thou shalt love<WH0157><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> with all thine heart<WH03824>, and with all thy soul<WH05315>, and with all thy might<WH03966>.
And these words<WH01697>, which I command<WH06680><WTH8764> thee this day<WH03117>, shall be in thine heart<WH03824>:

And thou shalt teach them diligently<WH08150><WTH8765> unto thy children<WH01121>, and shalt talk<WH01696><WTH8765> of them when thou sittest<WH03427><WTH8800> in thine house<WH01004>, and when thou walkest<WH03212><WTH8800> by the way<WH01870>, and when thou liest down<WH07901><WTH8800>, and when thou risest up<WH06965><WTH8800>. <RF>teach: Heb. whet, or, sharpen<Rf>
And thou shalt bind<WH07194><WTH8804> them for a sign<WH0226> upon thine hand<WH03027>, and they shall be as frontlets<WH02903> between thine eyes<WH05869>.
And thou shalt write<WH03789><WTH8804> them upon the posts<WH04201> of thy house<WH01004>, and on thy gates<WH08179>.

And it shall be, when the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> shall have brought<WH0935><WTH8686> thee into the land<WH0776> which he sware<WH07650><WTH8738> unto thy fathers<WH01>, to Abraham<WH085>, to Isaac<WH03327>, and to Jacob<WH03290>, to give<WH05414><WTH8800> thee great<WH01419> and goodly<WH02896> cities<WH05892>, which thou buildedst<WH01129><WTH8804> not,

And houses<WH01004> full<WH04392> of all good<WH02898> <FI>things<Fi> , which thou filledst<WH04390><WTH8765> not, and wells<WH0953> digged<WH02672><WTH8803>, which thou diggedst<WH02672><WTH8804> not, vineyards<WH03754> and olive trees<WH02132>, which thou plantedst<WH05193><WTH8804> not; when thou shalt have eaten<WH0398><WTH8804> and be full<WH07646><WTH8804>;

<FI> Then<Fi> beware<WH08104><WTH8734> lest thou forget<WH07911><WTH8799> the LORD<WH03068>, which brought thee forth<WH03318><WTH8689> out of the land<WH0776> of Egypt<WH04714>, from the house<WH01004> of bondage<WH05650>. <RF>bondage: Heb. bondmen or, servants<Rf>
Thou shalt fear<WH03372><WTH8799> the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430>, and serve<WH05647><WTH8799> him, and shalt swear<WH07650><WTH8735> by his name<WH08034>.
Ye shall not go<WH03212><WTH8799> after<WH0310> other<WH0312> gods<WH0430>, of the gods<WH0430> of the people<WH05971> which <FI>are<Fi> round about<WH05439> you;

(For the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> <FI>is<Fi> a jealous<WH07067> God<WH0410> among<WH07130> you) lest the anger<WH0639> of the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> be kindled<WH02734><WTH8799> against thee, and destroy<WH08045><WTH8689> thee from off the face<WH06440> of the earth<WH0127>.
Ye shall not tempt<WH05254><WTH8762> the LORD<WH03068> your God<WH0430>, as ye tempted<WH05254><WTH8765> <FI>him<Fi> in Massah<WH04532>.<CM>

Ye shall diligently<WH08104><WTH8800> keep<WH08104><WTH8799> the commandments<WH04687> of the LORD<WH03068> your God<WH0430>, and his testimonies<WH05713>, and his statutes<WH02706>, which he hath commanded<WH06680><WTH8765> thee.

And thou shalt do<WH06213><WTH8804> <FI>that which is<Fi> right<WH03477> and good<WH02896> in the sight<WH05869> of the LORD<WH03068>: that it may be well<WH03190><WTH8799> with thee, and that thou mayest go in<WH0935><WTH8804> and possess<WH03423><WTH8804> the good<WH02896> land<WH0776> which the LORD<WH03068> sware<WH07650><WTH8738> unto thy fathers<WH01>,
To cast out<WH01920><WTH8800> all thine enemies<WH0341><WTH8802> from before<WH06440> thee, as the LORD<WH03068> hath spoken<WH01696><WTH8765>.

<FI> And<Fi> when thy son<WH01121> asketh<WH07592><WTH8799> thee in time to come<WH04279>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, What <FI>mean<Fi> the testimonies<WH05713>, and the statutes<WH02706>, and the judgments<WH04941>, which the LORD<WH03068> our God<WH0430> hath commanded<WH06680><WTH8765> you? <RF>in...: Heb. to morrow<Rf>

Then thou shalt say<WH0559><WTH8804> unto thy son<WH01121>, We were Pharaoh's<WH06547> bondmen<WH05650> in Egypt<WH04714>; and the LORD<WH03068> brought us out<WH03318><WTH8686> of Egypt<WH04714> with a mighty<WH02389> hand<WH03027>:

And the LORD<WH03068> shewed<WH05414><WTH8799> signs<WH0226> and wonders<WH04159>, great<WH01419> and sore<WH07451>, upon Egypt<WH04714>, upon Pharaoh<WH06547>, and upon all his household<WH01004>, before our eyes<WH05869>: <RF>sore: Heb. evil<Rf>
And he brought us out<WH03318><WTH8689> from thence, that he might bring us in<WH0935><WTH8687>, to give<WH05414><WTH8800> us the land<WH0776> which he sware<WH07650><WTH8738> unto our fathers<WH01>.

And the LORD<WH03068> commanded<WH06680><WTH8762> us to do<WH06213><WTH8800> all these statutes<WH02706>, to fear<WH03372><WTH8800> the LORD<WH03068> our God<WH0430>, for our good<WH02896> always<WH03117>, that he might preserve us alive<WH02421><WTH8763>, as <FI>it is<Fi> at this day<WH03117>.

And it shall be our righteousness<WH06666>, if we observe<WH08104><WTH8799> to do<WH06213><WTH8800> all these<WH02063> commandments<WH04687> before<WH06440> the LORD<WH03068> our God<WH0430>, as he hath commanded<WH06680><WTH8765> us.<CM>
